report.root_cause_summary: The frontend slowdown is caused by a timeout in the cart service when adding to cart, which delays the response to the frontend.

evidence.snippet:

============================================================

recommended_actions: Check the health and recent changes of cart.
report.reasoning_trace_summary: log search: log.level: ("ERROR" OR "WARN") -> 10 lines | cart: accepted (topology, timing and grounding checks passed)
